policy.description: The engine permits at most 40% of each configured provider quota. A quota must be entered using the real limit for the account/plan or an explicitly documented internal cap.

sources.name: Pexels
sources.notes: Enter the actual account/API limits before enabling.

sources.name: Pixabay
sources.notes: Use the current account's documented API quota and caching rules.

sources.name: Coverr
sources.notes: COVERR_API_KEY is the credential used by the current connector design. COVERR_API_ID is also registered in Vercel but remains optional until the selected Coverr endpoint requires it.

sources.name: Vecteezy
sources.notes: Set limits from the account's actual API plan.

sources.name: Twitch
sources.notes: Twitch may expose bucket-specific limits in response headers; configure conservative limits and honor those headers in the connector.

sources.name: Vimeo
sources.notes: Set the quota for the authenticated Vimeo app/account.

sources.name: TMDB
sources.notes: Confirm the current account's applicable policy before activation.

sources.name: NASA APIs
sources.notes: The limit depends on DEMO_KEY versus a registered API key.

sources.name: NARA
sources.notes: Confirm quota and terms for the API endpoint/account used.

sources.name: DPLA
sources.notes: Set the documented quota for the issued key.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.notes: Public does not mean unlimited. Set an internal operating cap based on API etiquette and response headers.

sources.name: Internet Archive
sources.notes: Set an internal cap; respect service guidance and back off on 429/503.

sources.name: NASA Image and Video Library
sources.notes: Treat separately from NASA APIs if it uses a different endpoint or quota.

sources.name: Europeana
sources.notes: API key registered in Vercel Production. Confirm the account quota and endpoint requirements before enabling.

sources.name: DVIDS
sources.notes: API key registered in Vercel Production. Confirm the account quota and endpoint requirements before enabling.

sources.name: Jamendo
sources.notes: Existing independent PWA; do not modify it. Add only if the PLAY project makes API calls directly.

sources.name: Audius
sources.notes: Existing independent PWA; do not modify it. Add only if the PLAY project makes API calls directly.
